lens: Geometry and proportion first, then colour. Scripts in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/bd010ea5-6deb-54d2-81da-591cf8fca07a/scratchpad/raterB44/ (d.py = raterB43/d.py ported to r44 vs r43; cov.py q17 cover; hw.py q15 cover widths; inline belt / cover / e11 measurements with the w43 boxes so q16 cover numbers are comparable). Candidate diff read from b6ea6d8 (now committed; same as the described working tree). Change fractions r43->r44 (px max channel diff > 6): q15 5.2 %, q16 8.8 %, q17 5.6 %; studio e7 23.9 %, e4b 21.5 %, e1 16.1 %, e11 13.9 %, e10 10.2 %, e4 8.8 %, e3 1.1 %, e2 / e5 / e6 / e8 / e9 < 0.05 %. Fabric geometry and textures unchanged.

priorIssues.note: Belt px (smooth, B/R > 1.6): q15 side blocks (69,102,152) / (66,99,150) B/R 2.21 / 2.27 (r43 3.7); q16 near-left (51,94,149) -> (69,105,156) B/R 2.9 -> 2.26, second row (48,89,143) -> (67,101,151); q17 tongue straps (67-70,102-105,153-156) B/R 2.25 (r43 3.6). Royal-blue cast gone. Remaining mismatch is now hue / value per strap, not chroma (see w44b-2).

Lit studio tongue strap e11 (116,168,211) -> (139,176,213), e7 (117,170,212) -> (137,174,212): greyer still vs y_47303 lit webbing (80,143,210) / (78,144,209). In the q17 scene the same strap is now too dark (70,105,156). Both point at the base hue (G/R 1.35) rather than its value; folded into w44b-2.
09a_econ.js: one gBox per strap pitched by -atan(dpanY/L). e11 / e7 straps are single straight bands with no risers (sbs_e11_panedge.png, sbs_e7_arm.png).

Side-block pillows gone (near and far LOD). q17 right block navy pillow px (r43 comps (584,215)-(618,259) (43,52,89), (577,254)-(620,319) (38,47,83), (857,279)-(929,349) (34,42,74)) now fabric / armrest / belt (152,157,173), (88,97,132), (81,92,128) - matches y_47303 / y_47301. In q15 the right side seat now matches y_47300 (no pillow) but the left side seat lost the pillow y_47300 shows (x 100-160, y 310-355): w44b-3.

q17 near-headrest cover px per 15-row band (x 640-740, y 60-220, sat < 0.3, 120 < max < 235): 31/36/53/46/39/32/24/20 -> 31/39/63/53/49/34/30/20, i.e. +15-25 % on the middle rows, total 4775 -> 5264 (+10 %), far short of the 2x check. Changed component (656,104)-(713,206) 1488 px (84,96,142) -> (109,117,151): more plate shows, but it still reads as a strip beside the wing (q17head_3.png). Part of the gap is the view: q17 looks at the seat ~20-25 deg more edge-on than y_47303, so the aisle wing hides the plate face. e3 side view now shows the plate standing proud of the pad with a light gap - plausible for a folded flap.

Latch at z -0.40 with the V narrower; q17 straps now run from the armrest to the pan front (navy strap x 490-600 at y ~400 with the latch at ~(490,410); right block tongue strap x 785-855, y 360-385), no longer 30-40 px stubs. Alternate latch offset visible in q15 (left vs right side seats) and e7.
Tucked branch (09a_econ.js:313-314) unchanged; centre-block stub / tongue still peek under the q15 pillows.

q16 right-block covers (740-835, 330-400) 48.5 -> 48.3, (830-920, 262-300) 57.3 -> 58.8 vs y_47301 102 / 158. Left-block covers lifted a little by the forward plate: second row 60.2 -> 69.8 and 85.9 -> 99.5 (photo 73-82), centre 44.3 -> 52.9.

details.refs: Unchanged; the q15 left side seat's back is now fully visible down to the pan (no pillow) and reads as the diamond lattice of y_47300's left block.

Held. q17 cover +10 % px (still a strip); head-on width 0.22 -> 0.232 (+5.5 %, about 4 px on a 75 px cover) - within tolerance, no visible q15 regression. But q15 outer covers lightened (darkest-40 % L 49.8 -> 60.7 left, 49.8 -> 60.5 right; B/R 1.97 -> 1.76) vs y_47300 56.8 left / 34.2 right: the left now matches, the right pair is further off (w44b-4). q16 left-block covers moved toward the photo.
Up 0.1 for placement: centre block only now matches y_47301 / y_47303 and y_47300's right side seat; y_47300's left side seat has one (w44b-3). Shape still a flat plaque (w41b-4).

Up 0.2: single pitched straps, latch forward, straps visible full length in q17 with the pillows gone, royal-blue cast gone (B/R 3.0-3.7 -> 2.2-2.3). Held below 9: q17 tongue strap (70,105,156) vs lit teal (80,143,210) and navy strap (25,30,59) L30 vs (46,61,96) L60; straps lie flat where y_47303's tongue strap hangs vertically from the cushion / armrest gap with slack and a bright silver tongue (202,224,243); render latch cover reads as a small grey block.
e8 bit-identical; e10 10 % is lighting / belt reflection only.
Side-block far pillows removed and far cover 0.232 / 1 cm forward, consistent with the near LOD; no visible change at q15 / q16 far-row scale.
